proof_requirements.physical_promotion: Digital or Raphael results never uplift physical capability without attributable empirical evidence tied to the exact configuration.

scientific_guardrails.energy: Free space/void can provide geometry, insulation, field volume or electrochemical working volume but is not an energy source.
scientific_guardrails.graphene: Graphene/carbon is a candidate conductor/electrode/feed family selected by measured performance, processability, safety, availability and lifecycle—not by default.
scientific_guardrails.recovered_materials: Recovered feed requires contamination and application-specific qualification.
scientific_guardrails.coatings: Geospatial sensor/control functions are testable; biological/resonant health effects are not presumed.
scientific_guardrails.recursion: Recursive manufacturing means staged capability growth through qualified child modules, not autonomous unlimited self-replication.
scientific_guardrails.debris: Tracking/tagging may inform safe action; deorbit/deflection needs separate orbital, regulatory and safety authority.
